changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.taxonomy_ann_query_384( p_embedding nexus.vector(384), p_collection text, p_cross_collection boolean, p_n int, p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS TABLE(topic_id bigint, distance float8) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ SELECT topic_id, (embedding_384 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) p_embedding)::float8 AS distance FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids WHERE embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND tenant_id = p_tenant AND embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND collection_id IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN p_cross_collection THEN collection_id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections rc WHERE rc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND rc.name = p_collection) ELSE collection_id = (SELECT rc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections rc WHERE rc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND rc.name = p_collection) END) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE p_cross_collection AND cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND cc.collection_id = nexus.taxonomy_centroids.collection_id AND cc.superseded_by_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY embedding_384 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) p_embedding, topic_id ASC LIMIT p_n $$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_health_meta WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT d.tenant_id, cc.name AS collection, max(d.indexed_at) AS last_indexed, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_links l WHERE l.to_tumbler = d.tumbler ) ) AS orphan_count, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.indexed_at IS NOT NULL AND d.indexed_at < now() - interval '30 days'))::double precision / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.indexed_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS stale_source_ratio FROM nexus.catalog_documents d JOIN nexus.catalog_collections cc ON cc.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND cc.collection_id = d.physical_collection_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY d.tenant_id, cc.name
